title: Home guide: the microhabitat hunt
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Properties of materials and habitats (Alchemy Island and Living Things and Their Habitats)
source: Written for science/y5 lesson 15 (Home practical guide and safety card: microhabitat hunt (portal worksheet; adult present, gloves, return creatures gently, wash hands))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Compare living things in two microhabitats.
equipment: A magnifying glass if you have one
safety: An adult is with you outside
Wear gloves; do not pick up anything that might sting
Put every creature back gently where you found it
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Choose two microhabitats: a plant pot, under a stone, a hedge.
Describe each: light or dark? damp or dry?
Look carefully for living things for 5 minutes. Count and draw them.
Put any stone or pot back as it was.
